title: Atmospheres series definition
description: A series is one scripted KSP session (or a few starts) that returns a fixed table of named metrics. The schema describes the series file tests/series/K-<name>.json (the root) and the row file tests/series/rows/<Id>.json (definitions.rowFile). tools/atmo_series.py validates both against this file with its own small validator (type, required, properties, additionalProperties, enum, items, minimum, maximum, minItems, pattern, $ref).

name.description: The series name; the file is K-<name>.json and the game gets -atmoSeries <name>.

owner.description: The package that owns the series definition's content (A02 owns the schema and the skeletons).

profile.description: The graphics profile of the start. Medium only on the A4500.

configuration.description: The build configuration of the DLLs the runner builds and deploys (default Debug). A series whose rows are defined by the Release build (a CPU budget) says Release; the report records the configuration that ran.

exclusive.description: A timing series: the GPU lock is taken exclusive, builders and dotnet test wait.

maxMinutes.description: Per start; the runner ends the game after this long. Never above 20.

freeMemoryGb.description: The free memory the start needs.

plannedStarts.description: The starts master plan 9.3 plans for this series (without repeats).

bundle.description: The series needs the shader bundle: the runner builds build/atmospheres.shaders with Unity in batch mode inside the unity lock after the DLL build, and refuses when it is missing afterwards.

settings.description: Settings the series pins for every start: per file, keys that must already stand in it and the values they get. The runner writes them after the Medium profile is applied and the snapshot restores the files byte for byte afterwards (never edit the installed files by hand).

expectProbeLine.description: Whether the log must carry 'Probe: PASSED' and no 'Probe: FAILED' (default true).

productSwitches.description: Atmospheres settings (key: wanted value, a number or a choice name) the series needs on for its probe to measure anything: the weather generator's gate (enabled, weatherEffects, genEnabled), the cloud renderer's (ownClouds, cloudSource). The preflight prints each with the value the start would have (the install's settings.cfg of the Atmospheres, else the default of the setting) and FAILs a key that is off and neither pinned in 'settings' nor set by the probe named in -atmoProbe (a SetSetting(AtmospheresSettings.Keys.<Key> in its source). Start-level keys win.

sections.description: The order of the table; a row names its section. Without sections, one section 'main'.

metrics.description: Scripts that compute result lines from the logs of all starts after the last start (a number that needs more than the ATMORESULT lines, such as the GPU profiler's milliseconds). The script (relative to the worktree) defines series_results(texts) -> [{metric, value, variant}], texts being {start id: log text}, and may fill a module list NOTES that the report prints. The values are judged by the rows like any other line; a script that raises fails the run.

rows.description: Rows of the skeleton itself; the packages' rows come from tests/series/rows/<Id>.json.

disableMods.description: The mods whose GameData folders are moved away for this start.

productSwitches.description: As the series-level key, for this start only (merged over the series': a key in both takes the start's value).

variants.description: Variants the probe switches inside this one start (-atmoVariants a,b).

probeArgs.description: More arguments for the game's command line.

settings.description: Pins of this start only: merged over the series' pins (a key named in both takes the start's value), written just before the start and put back with the snapshot. KSP applies SCREEN_RESOLUTION_WIDTH, SCREEN_RESOLUTION_HEIGHT and FULLSCREEN from settings.cfg over the command line, so a start with its own window size pins them here.

file.description: Relative to the KSP folder; only files the runner snapshots: KSP's settings.cfg or a ReDefinition PluginData settings.cfg.

set.description: key: value (strings or numbers); the key must already stand in the file as 'key = value'.

from.description: A file or folder relative to the KSP folder.

series.description: Only in a row file: the series the row belongs to.

start.description: The start whose log carries the line (default: any start).

variant.description: The variant the line names (default: any).

required.description: Default true: a missing line fails the series.
